lines.beaver_en: Hello. I'm the guide. How can I help you?
lines.learner: 서울역에 가는 길에 우체국에 들르고 싶어요.
lines.en: I'd like to stop by the post office on the way to Seoul Station.
lines.roman: seoullyeoge ganeun gire ucheguge deureugo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver: 네, 우체국은 역 가는 길에 있어요. 걸어서 가세요?
lines.beaver_en: Sure, the post office is on the way to the station. Are you walking?
lines.beaver_roman: ne, uchegugeun yeok ganeun gire isseoyo. georeoseo gaseyo?
lines.learner: 네, 걸어서 가요. 약도가 있으면 좋겠어요.
lines.en: Yes, I'm walking. A simple map would be nice.
lines.roman: ne, georeoseo gayo. yakdoga isseumyeon jokesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 여기 약도가 있어요. 먼저 큰길로 나가세요.
lines.beaver_en: Here's a map. First, go out to the main road.
lines.beaver_roman: yeogi yakdoga isseoyo. meonjeo keungillo nagaseyo.
lines.en: Do I go out to the main road and go straight?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, go straight, then turn left at the crossing.
lines.en: I turn left at the crossing, right?

lines.beaver_en: That's right. After the left turn, you'll see a sign board.
lines.en: Where do I go after the sign board?

lines.beaver: 안내판 옆 골목으로 들어가면 더 빨라요.
lines.beaver_en: It's faster if you go into the alley next to the sign.
lines.beaver_roman: annaepan yeop golmogeuro deureogamyeon deo ppallayo.
lines.en: Oh, there's an alley? Is it faster than the main road?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, about 5 minutes faster. Turn right at the end of the alley.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, obunjjeum ppallayo. golmok kkeuteseo uhoejeonhaseyo.
lines.en: If I turn right at the end, is the post office there?

lines.beaver: 네, 오른쪽 세 번째 건물이 우체국이에요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, the third building on the right is the post office.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, oreunjjok se beonjjae geonmuri uchegugieyo.
lines.en: The third building. And from there to the station?

lines.beaver_en: Come out of the post office and keep going straight to the station.
lines.learner: 그럼 역에 가는 길에 약국도 있어요?
lines.en: Then is there a pharmacy on the way to the station too?
lines.roman: geureom yeoge ganeun gire yakgukdo isseoyo?

lines.beaver: 네, 우체국 바로 옆에 약국이 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, there's a pharmacy right next to the post office.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, ucheguk baro yeope yakgugi isseoyo.
lines.learner: 잘 알겠어요. 이따 가는 길에 들를게요. 감사합니다!
lines.en: Got it. I'll stop by on my way later. Thank you!
lines.roman: jal algesseoyo. itta ganeun gire deureulgeyo. gamsahamnida!
